#### Full job description

Lead the vision, strategy, and roadmap for our paid search and paid social offering in multifamily housing, turning client and business goals into smart strategies that consistently deliver measurable results for our properties.

### **About 30 Lines**

About 30 Lines

30 Lines is a digital marketing agency built for the multifamily industry. We run the websites, search, advertising, and lead nurturing behind hundreds of apartment communities across the country, and we have been doing it long enough to know the difference between marketing that looks good in a report and marketing that fills apartments.

We are a small, senior team. The work you own is genuinely yours, the person who builds something decides how it runs, and there is no layer between you and the client outcome. We are fully remote and distributed across the country, and we care more about the quality of the thinking than where or when it happens.

We are also an AI-forward company. Our tools are changing how the work gets done, and we would rather hire people who want to push on that than people who need convincing.

### **Description**

DEPARTMENT

Product / Paid Media

LOCATION

Remote (US)

ROLE TYPE

Full-time

COMPENSATION $60,000–$65,000 base salary (DOE & location), plus benefits.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Paid Media Specialist to lead the vision, strategy, and roadmap for our paid search and paid social offering in the multifamily housing space. You’ll partner closely with Account Managers and the PPC team to translate client and business goals into smart strategies, prioritize work across accounts, and make sure our campaigns and processes consistently deliver measurable results for our properties.

This is a strategic role. You’ll spend more time shaping the product, roadmap, and client-level strategies and less time doing repetitive campaign maintenance. You’ll also help us get the most out of tools like Asana and AI to make our work smarter, faster, and more consistent.

What You’ll Do

- Own and continuously refine the PPC product vision and roadmap for multifamily clients across paid search and paid social.
- Partner with Account Managers to build and evolve client-specific PPC strategies that support property-level goals (occupancy, lease-ups, renewals, lead quality).
- Lead structured audits of accounts, using standardized frameworks to evaluate structure, targeting, creative, tracking, performance, and compliance.
- Identify cross-client trends and opportunities and turn them into prioritized initiatives, tests, and process improvements.
- Design and improve workflows, playbooks, templates, and QA standards so work is scalable, consistent, and aligned with fair-housing principles.
- Use AI tools (such as Claude) to support research, analysis, and ideation, and turn outputs into clear, actionable tasks in Asana.
- Partner with analytics and technical teammates to ensure accurate tracking (GA4, GTM, Meta Pixel, CRM integrations) and reporting that connects marketing to business outcomes.
- Build and maintain internal playbooks, training, and documentation for PPC strategy, testing, and compliance.
- Provide ongoing enablement for PPC specialists and Account Managers, helping them understand not just what to do, but why we’re doing it.

What Success Looks Like

- Campaigns are better structured, better measured, and more effective at supporting occupancy and leasing goals.
- AMs and clients see a clear PPC strategy and roadmap instead of a series of one-off optimizations.
- Asana is a well-organized source of truth for PPC work, with strong templates and fewer ad-hoc tasks.
- Audits and health scorecards become routine, and account quality improves quarter over quarter.
- Fair-housing-aligned messaging and targeting practices are consistently applied and proactively managed.

What We’re Looking For

- 3–5+ years of experience in PPC / paid media strategy (agency or in-house), managing or overseeing multiple accounts.
- Experience in multifamily housing, real estate, or a closely related industry strongly preferred.
- Proven ability to own and lead PPC strategy and priorities across a portfolio of clients or product lines.
- Strong analytical skills and hands-on experience with Google Ads, Meta Ads, GA4, and Google Tag Manager.
- Familiarity with fair-housing advertising requirements (or a strong demonstrated ability to learn and apply them quickly).
- Experience working inside structured systems like Asana, Jira, or similar to translate strategy into clear tasks and projects.
- Excellent communication skills — you’re comfortable distilling complex performance data into simple, actionable recommendations.
- Process-oriented mindset; you enjoy building and improving frameworks, templates, and workflows.
- Interest in or experience with AI-powered tools to support analysis, ideation, and workflow automation.

30 Lines provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training. 30 Lines is an E-Verify employer.

$60,000 - $65,000 per year

fields.responsibilities:
- Own and continuously refine the PPC product vision and roadmap for multifamily clients across paid search and paid social.
- Partner with Account Managers to build and evolve client-specific PPC strategies that support property-level goals (occupancy, lease-ups, renewals, lead quality).
- Lead structured audits of accounts, using standardized frameworks to evaluate structure, targeting, creative, tracking, performance, and compliance.
- Identify cross-client trends and opportunities and turn them into prioritized initiatives, tests, and process improvements.
- Design and improve workflows, playbooks, templates, and QA standards so work is scalable, consistent, and aligned with fair-housing principles.
- Use AI tools (such as Claude) to support research, analysis, and ideation, and turn outputs into clear, actionable tasks in Asana.
- Partner with analytics and technical teammates to ensure accurate tracking (GA4, GTM, Meta Pixel, CRM integrations) and reporting that connects marketing to business outcomes.
- Build and maintain internal playbooks, training, and documentation for PPC strategy, testing, and compliance.
- Provide ongoing enablement for PPC specialists and Account Managers, helping them understand not just what to do, but why we’re doing it.

What Success Looks Like

- Campaigns are better structured, better measured, and more effective at supporting occupancy and leasing goals.
- AMs and clients see a clear PPC strategy and roadmap instead of a series of one-off optimizations.
- Asana is a well-organized source of truth for PPC work, with strong templates and fewer ad-hoc tasks.
- Audits and health scorecards become routine, and account quality improves quarter over quarter.
- Fair-housing-aligned messaging and targeting practices are consistently applied and proactively managed.

What We’re Looking For

- 3–5+ years of experience in PPC / paid media strategy (agency or in-house), managing or overseeing multiple accounts.
- Experience in multifamily housing, real estate, or a closely related industry strongly preferred.
- Proven ability to own and lead PPC strategy and priorities across a portfolio of clients or product lines.
- Strong analytical skills and hands-on experience with Google Ads, Meta Ads, GA4, and Google Tag Manager.
- Familiarity with fair-housing advertising requirements (or a strong demonstrated ability to learn and apply them quickly).
- Experience working inside structured systems like Asana, Jira, or similar to translate strategy into clear tasks and projects.
- Excellent communication skills — you’re comfortable distilling complex performance data into simple, actionable recommendations.
- Process-oriented mindset; you enjoy building and improving frameworks, templates, and workflows.
- Interest in or experience with AI-powered tools to support analysis, ideation, and workflow automation.

### **About 30 Lines**

About 30 Lines

30 Lines is a digital marketing agency built for the multifamily industry. We run the websites, search, advertising, and lead nurturing behind hundreds of apartment communities across the country, and we have been doing it long enough to know the difference between marketing that looks good in a report and marketing that fills apartments.

We are a small, senior team. The work you own is genuinely yours, the person who builds something decides how it runs, and there is no layer between you and the client outcome. We are fully remote and distributed across the country, and we care more about the quality of the thinking than where or when it happens.

We are also an AI-forward company. Our tools are changing how the work gets done, and we would rather hire people who want to push on that than people who need convincing.

You’ll partner closely with Account Managers and the PPC team to translate client and business goals into smart strategies, prioritize work across accounts, and make sure our campaigns and processes consistently deliver measurable results for our properties.

What Success Looks Like

details.original_description:
Lead the vision, strategy, and roadmap for our paid search and paid social offering in multifamily housing, turning client and business goals into smart strategies that consistently deliver measurable results for our properties.

About 30 Lines

About 30 Lines
30 Lines is a digital marketing agency built for the multifamily industry. We run the websites, search, advertising, and lead nurturing behind hundreds of apartment communities across the country, and we have been doing it long enough to know the difference between marketing that looks good in a report and marketing that fills apartments.

We are a small, senior team. The work you own is genuinely yours, the person who builds something decides how it runs, and there is no layer between you and the client outcome. We are fully remote and distributed across the country, and we care more about the quality of the thinking than where or when it happens.

We are also an AI-forward company. Our tools are changing how the work gets done, and we would rather hire people who want to push on that than people who need convincing.

Description



DEPARTMENT

Product / Paid Media

LOCATION

Remote (US)

ROLE TYPE

Full-time

COMPENSATION $60,000–$65,000 base salary (DOE & location), plus benefits.


About the Role

We’re looking for a Paid Media Specialist to lead the vision, strategy, and roadmap for our paid search and paid social offering in the multifamily housing space. You’ll partner closely with Account Managers and the PPC team to translate client and business goals into smart strategies, prioritize work across accounts, and make sure our campaigns and processes consistently deliver measurable results for our properties.

This is a strategic role. You’ll spend more time shaping the product, roadmap, and client-level strategies and less time doing repetitive campaign maintenance. You’ll also help us get the most out of tools like Asana and AI to make our work smarter, faster, and more consistent.


What You’ll Do

  • Own and continuously refine the PPC product vision and roadmap for multifamily clients across paid search and paid social.
  • Partner with Account Managers to build and evolve client-specific PPC strategies that support property-level goals (occupancy, lease-ups, renewals, lead quality).
  • Lead structured audits of accounts, using standardized frameworks to evaluate structure, targeting, creative, tracking, performance, and compliance.
  • Identify cross-client trends and opportunities and turn them into prioritized initiatives, tests, and process improvements.
  • Design and improve workflows, playbooks, templates, and QA standards so work is scalable, consistent, and aligned with fair-housing principles.
  • Use AI tools (such as Claude) to support research, analysis, and ideation, and turn outputs into clear, actionable tasks in Asana.
  • Partner with analytics and technical teammates to ensure accurate tracking (GA4, GTM, Meta Pixel, CRM integrations) and reporting that connects marketing to business outcomes.
  • Build and maintain internal playbooks, training, and documentation for PPC strategy, testing, and compliance.
  • Provide ongoing enablement for PPC specialists and Account Managers, helping them understand not just what to do, but why we’re doing it.


What Success Looks Like

  • Campaigns are better structured, better measured, and more effective at supporting occupancy and leasing goals.
  • AMs and clients see a clear PPC strategy and roadmap instead of a series of one-off optimizations.
  • Asana is a well-organized source of truth for PPC work, with strong templates and fewer ad-hoc tasks.
  • Audits and health scorecards become routine, and account quality improves quarter over quarter.
  • Fair-housing-aligned messaging and targeting practices are consistently applied and proactively managed.


What We’re Looking For

  • 3–5+ years of experience in PPC / paid media strategy (agency or in-house), managing or overseeing multiple accounts.
  • Experience in multifamily housing, real estate, or a closely related industry strongly preferred.
  • Proven ability to own and lead PPC strategy and priorities across a portfolio of clients or product lines.
  • Strong analytical skills and hands-on experience with Google Ads, Meta Ads, GA4, and Google Tag Manager.
  • Familiarity with fair-housing advertising requirements (or a strong demonstrated ability to learn and apply them quickly).
  • Experience working inside structured systems like Asana, Jira, or similar to translate strategy into clear tasks and projects.
  • Excellent communication skills — you’re comfortable distilling complex performance data into simple, actionable recommendations.
  • Process-oriented mindset; you enjoy building and improving frameworks, templates, and workflows.
  • Interest in or experience with AI-powered tools to support analysis, ideation, and workflow automation.


30 Lines provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training. 30 Lines is an E-Verify employer.


Salary

$60,000 - $65,000 per year

<div>
 <div>
  <p>Lead the vision, strategy, and roadmap for our paid search and paid social offering in multifamily housing, turning client and business goals into smart strategies that consistently deliver measurable results for our properties.</p>
 </div>
 <div>
  <h3><b>About 30 Lines</b></h3>
  <div>
   <div>
    <p>About 30 Lines <br>
      30 Lines is a digital marketing agency built for the multifamily industry. We run the websites, search, advertising, and lead nurturing behind hundreds of apartment communities across the country, and we have been doing it long enough to know the difference between marketing that looks good in a report and marketing that fills apartments.</p>
    <p>We are a small, senior team. The work you own is genuinely yours, the person who builds something decides how it runs, and there is no layer between you and the client outcome. We are fully remote and distributed across the country, and we care more about the quality of the thinking than where or when it happens.</p>
    <p>We are also an AI-forward company. Our tools are changing how the work gets done, and we would rather hire people who want to push on that than people who need convincing.</p>
   </div>
  </div>
 </div>
 <div>
  <h3><b>Description</b></h3>
  <br>
  <p></p>
  <div>
   <div>
    <br>
    <p>DEPARTMENT</p>
    <p>Product / Paid Media</p>
    <p>LOCATION</p>
    <p>Remote (US)</p>
    <p>ROLE TYPE</p>
    <p>Full-time</p>
    <p>COMPENSATION $60,000–$65,000 base salary (DOE & location), plus benefits.</p>
    <p></p>
    <p><br>
      About the Role</p>
    <p>We’re looking for a Paid Media Specialist to lead the vision, strategy, and roadmap for our paid search and paid social offering in the multifamily housing space. You’ll partner closely with Account Managers and the PPC team to translate client and business goals into smart strategies, prioritize work across accounts, and make sure our campaigns and processes consistently deliver measurable results for our properties.</p>
    <p>This is a strategic role. You’ll spend more time shaping the product, roadmap, and client-level strategies and less time doing repetitive campaign maintenance. You’ll also help us get the most out of tools like Asana and AI to make our work smarter, faster, and more consistent.</p>
    <p></p>
    <p><br>
      What You’ll Do</p>
    <ul>
     <li>Own and continuously refine the PPC product vision and roadmap for multifamily clients across paid search and paid social.</li>
     <li>Partner with Account Managers to build and evolve client-specific PPC strategies that support property-level goals (occupancy, lease-ups, renewals, lead quality).</li>
     <li>Lead structured audits of accounts, using standardized frameworks to evaluate structure, targeting, creative, tracking, performance, and compliance.</li>
     <li>Identify cross-client trends and opportunities and turn them into prioritized initiatives, tests, and process improvements.</li>
     <li>Design and improve workflows, playbooks, templates, and QA standards so work is scalable, consistent, and aligned with fair-housing principles.</li>
     <li>Use AI tools (such as Claude) to support research, analysis, and ideation, and turn outputs into clear, actionable tasks in Asana.</li>
     <li>Partner with analytics and technical teammates to ensure accurate tracking (GA4, GTM, Meta Pixel, CRM integrations) and reporting that connects marketing to business outcomes.</li>
     <li>Build and maintain internal playbooks, training, and documentation for PPC strategy, testing, and compliance.</li>
     <li>Provide ongoing enablement for PPC specialists and Account Managers, helping them understand not just what to do, but why we’re doing it.</li>
    </ul>
    <p></p>
    <p><br>
      What Success Looks Like</p>
    <ul>
     <li>Campaigns are better structured, better measured, and more effective at supporting occupancy and leasing goals.</li>
     <li>AMs and clients see a clear PPC strategy and roadmap instead of a series of one-off optimizations.</li>
     <li>Asana is a well-organized source of truth for PPC work, with strong templates and fewer ad-hoc tasks.</li>
     <li>Audits and health scorecards become routine, and account quality improves quarter over quarter.</li>
     <li>Fair-housing-aligned messaging and targeting practices are consistently applied and proactively managed.</li>
    </ul>
    <p></p>
    <p><br>
      What We’re Looking For</p>
    <ul>
     <li>3–5+ years of experience in PPC / paid media strategy (agency or in-house), managing or overseeing multiple accounts.</li>
     <li>Experience in multifamily housing, real estate, or a closely related industry strongly preferred.</li>
     <li>Proven ability to own and lead PPC strategy and priorities across a portfolio of clients or product lines.</li>
     <li>Strong analytical skills and hands-on experience with Google Ads, Meta Ads, GA4, and Google Tag Manager.</li>
     <li>Familiarity with fair-housing advertising requirements (or a strong demonstrated ability to learn and apply them quickly).</li>
     <li>Experience working inside structured systems like Asana, Jira, or similar to translate strategy into clear tasks and projects.</li>
     <li>Excellent communication skills — you’re comfortable distilling complex performance data into simple, actionable recommendations.</li>
     <li>Process-oriented mindset; you enjoy building and improving frameworks, templates, and workflows.</li>
     <li>Interest in or experience with AI-powered tools to support analysis, ideation, and workflow automation.</li>
    </ul>
    <p></p>
    <p><br>
      30 Lines provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training. 30 Lines is an E-Verify employer.</p>
    <br>
    <p></p>
   </div>
  </div>

  <h4><b>Salary</b></h4>
  <p>$60,000 - $65,000 per year</p>

#### Full job description

We are seeking a Senior Paid Media Manager with deep client-facing and local marketing experience to join our expanding team. You’ll directly manage search engine marketing (SEM) campaigns across both Google Ads (Search, Display, Shopping, Performance Max, YouTube) and Microsoft Ads, making optimizations and updates daily. You will also support the team with Meta Ads campaigns. Your complex and diverse portfolio of clients will be a mix of local and SMBs that constantly challenge you with goals to maximize performance, reach, and customer acquisition across these channels. In addition to managing paid media execution, this role partners with our local marketing teams to oversee delivery of Local SEO, AI Visibility (AIO/GEO), Google Business Profile, Local Listings, and organic Social Media programs — and serves as the client’s voice for those channels on monthly performance calls.

The Senior Paid Media Manager will report to the Director, Franchise Partnerships. The position will also work with our global support teams within AdMax Local. You should be able to work well as part of a distributed team and provide innovative solutions to the new problems and opportunities that arise every week. In addition, you should have the ability to function equally well independently and as part of a team, as well as the ability to adapt to the changing digital marketing landscape and the use of AI.

This remote role may require one in-person client event per year.

**Key Responsibilities:**

- Plan, develop, and execute comprehensive paid media strategies to drive revenue, direct response, qualified leads, and new user acquisition for your book of clients
- Utilize business acumen to work closely with client teams to identify and fully understand business needs, campaign performance objectives, and opportunities to grow relationships and client investments
- Manage Search, Performance Max, Display, Social, Remarketing, and Video advertising campaigns within the native Google, Meta, and Microsoft platforms and the proprietary AdMax Local platform
- Oversee delivery of Local SEO, AI Visibility (AIO/GEO), Google Business Profile/Local Listings, and organic Social Media programs executed by specialized internal teams, ensuring on-time, on-brand, and on-strategy execution for every client (this role manages and quality-checks the work)
- Confidently communicate strategy and campaign progress to clients through weekly calls and emails; Present and discuss organic/local SEO and AI Visibility performance on monthly client performance calls, translating concepts, deliverables, and results into clear business impact
- Provide recommendations and execute strategies for ad copy, keyword opportunities, campaign structuring, targeting, creative, display network, and other facets of Google inventory
- Integrate consumer and business insights into media to enhance targeting and tracking efforts
- Optimize performance marketing campaigns to meet and exceed SEM and paid social campaign benchmarks through channel-specific levers utilizing industry best practices
- Responsible for monthly reporting on campaign performance with a keen eye toward media optimization to ensure efficient and effective campaign execution
- Responsible for tight management of paid media budget, providing timely management of platform setup, invoicing, and accruals
- Manage the creative development process, including writing creative briefs, trafficking, creative insights, ensuring timely delivery, and alignment with client direction. Requires a solid understanding of the creative process and creative development best business practices.

**Qualifications:**

- US-based applicants only
- 7+ years of experience managing multiple client portfolios in SEM (Search, Display, Remarketing, App Install). 1+ years of Performance Max and Shopping experience.
- 5-7+ years of experience managing multiple client portfolios in paid social (Facebook/Instagram)
- TikTok, Snapchat, Pinterest, and Twitter are a plus
- Working knowledge of Local SEO, Google Business Profile, local listings/citation management, online reputation management, and organic social media management — sufficient to oversee specialist teams and confidently discuss performance and recommendations with clients on monthly calls
- Familiarity with AI Visibility / Answer Engine Optimization (AIO/GEO) concepts and how they intersect with traditional SEO
- 7+ years of experience in Client Management (Must be comfortable with a high volume of client meetings, some weeks)
- Experience working and developing strategies for clients with multiple franchise locations.
- Strong ability to multitask, prioritize, and respond with an appropriate sense of urgency in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
- Proven track record of successfully planning and executing Paid Search, Paid Social, Paid Display, and YouTube campaign management and optimizations at scale
- Strong analytical skills and experience with data analysis, attribution, ads implementation, and platform integration (Excel skills required)
- Detail-oriented, able to build project plans and presentations with strategic input
- A proactive mindset, strong work ethic, and ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional leads and existing teams
- Experience driving campaigns from concept through to execution, and performing post-campaign analysis
- Experience with analytics/tracking tools: Google Analytics (Universal & GA4), SEMRush, Google Tag Manager, Meta Business Suite
- Experience optimizing landing pages and performing A/B and multivariate testing
- Experience leveraging AI to improve the quality of work output and turnaround time
- Ability to work both independently and as part of a team in a professional business environment
- Bachelor’s degree required, Master’s degree a plus
- Bing Ads Accredited Professional (Preferred)
- Google AdWords Certified (Preferred)
- Meta BluePrint Certified (Preferred)
- Google Analytics Certified is a plus

**Compensation & Benefits:**

- Salary range $90k - $120k depending on experience and location
- Remote environment
- Health/dental/vision benefits
- Unlimited PTO
- 401(k) plan

#### Full job description

We are seeking a Senior Paid Media Manager with deep client-facing and local marketing experience to join our expanding team. You’ll directly manage search engine marketing (SEM) campaigns across both Google Ads (Search, Display, Shopping, Performance Max, YouTube) and Microsoft Ads, making optimizations and updates daily. You will also support the team with Meta Ads campaigns. Your complex and diverse portfolio of clients will be a mix of local and SMBs that constantly challenge you with goals to maximize performance, reach, and customer acquisition across these channels. In addition to managing paid media execution, this role partners with our local marketing teams to oversee delivery of Local SEO, AI Visibility (AIO/GEO), Google Business Profile, Local Listings, and organic Social Media programs — and serves as the client’s voice for those channels on monthly performance calls.

The Senior Paid Media Manager will report to the Director, Franchise Partnerships. The position will also work with our global support teams within AdMax Local. You should be able to work well as part of a distributed team and provide innovative solutions to the new problems and opportunities that arise every week. In addition, you should have the ability to function equally well independently and as part of a team, as well as the ability to adapt to the changing digital marketing landscape and the use of AI.

This remote role may require one in-person client event per year.

**Key Responsibilities:**

- Plan, develop, and execute comprehensive paid media strategies to drive revenue, direct response, qualified leads, and new user acquisition for your book of clients
- Utilize business acumen to work closely with client teams to identify and fully understand business needs, campaign performance objectives, and opportunities to grow relationships and client investments
- Manage Search, Performance Max, Display, Social, Remarketing, and Video advertising campaigns within the native Google, Meta, and Microsoft platforms and the proprietary AdMax Local platform
- Oversee delivery of Local SEO, AI Visibility (AIO/GEO), Google Business Profile/Local Listings, and organic Social Media programs executed by specialized internal teams, ensuring on-time, on-brand, and on-strategy execution for every client (this role manages and quality-checks the work)
- Confidently communicate strategy and campaign progress to clients through weekly calls and emails; Present and discuss organic/local SEO and AI Visibility performance on monthly client performance calls, translating concepts, deliverables, and results into clear business impact
- Provide recommendations and execute strategies for ad copy, keyword opportunities, campaign structuring, targeting, creative, display network, and other facets of Google inventory
- Integrate consumer and business insights into media to enhance targeting and tracking efforts
- Optimize performance marketing campaigns to meet and exceed SEM and paid social campaign benchmarks through channel-specific levers utilizing industry best practices
- Responsible for monthly reporting on campaign performance with a keen eye toward media optimization to ensure efficient and effective campaign execution
- Responsible for tight management of paid media budget, providing timely management of platform setup, invoicing, and accruals
- Manage the creative development process, including writing creative briefs, trafficking, creative insights, ensuring timely delivery, and alignment with client direction. Requires a solid understanding of the creative process and creative development best business practices.

**Qualifications:**

- US-based applicants only
- 7+ years of experience managing multiple client portfolios in SEM (Search, Display, Remarketing, App Install). 1+ years of Performance Max and Shopping experience.
- 5-7+ years of experience managing multiple client portfolios in paid social (Facebook/Instagram)
- TikTok, Snapchat, Pinterest, and Twitter are a plus
- Working knowledge of Local SEO, Google Business Profile, local listings/citation management, online reputation management, and organic social media management — sufficient to oversee specialist teams and confidently discuss performance and recommendations with clients on monthly calls
- Familiarity with AI Visibility / Answer Engine Optimization (AIO/GEO) concepts and how they intersect with traditional SEO
- 7+ years of experience in Client Management (Must be comfortable with a high volume of client meetings, some weeks)
- Experience working and developing strategies for clients with multiple franchise locations.
- Strong ability to multitask, prioritize, and respond with an appropriate sense of urgency in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
- Proven track record of successfully planning and executing Paid Search, Paid Social, Paid Display, and YouTube campaign management and optimizations at scale
- Strong analytical skills and experience with data analysis, attribution, ads implementation, and platform integration (Excel skills required)
- Detail-oriented, able to build project plans and presentations with strategic input
- A proactive mindset, strong work ethic, and ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional leads and existing teams
- Experience driving campaigns from concept through to execution, and performing post-campaign analysis
- Experience with analytics/tracking tools: Google Analytics (Universal & GA4), SEMRush, Google Tag Manager, Meta Business Suite
- Experience optimizing landing pages and performing A/B and multivariate testing
- Experience leveraging AI to improve the quality of work output and turnaround time
- Ability to work both independently and as part of a team in a professional business environment
- Bachelor’s degree required, Master’s degree a plus
- Bing Ads Accredited Professional (Preferred)
- Google AdWords Certified (Preferred)
- Meta BluePrint Certified (Preferred)
- Google Analytics Certified is a plus

**Compensation & Benefits:**

- Salary range $90k - $120k depending on experience and location
- Remote environment
- Health/dental/vision benefits
- Unlimited PTO
- 401(k) plan

#### Full job description

We are seeking a Senior Paid Media Manager with deep client-facing and local marketing experience to join our expanding team. You’ll directly manage search engine marketing (SEM) campaigns across both Google Ads (Search, Display, Shopping, Performance Max, YouTube) and Microsoft Ads, making optimizations and updates daily. You will also support the team with Meta Ads campaigns. Your complex and diverse portfolio of clients will be a mix of local and SMBs that constantly challenge you with goals to maximize performance, reach, and customer acquisition across these channels. In addition to managing paid media execution, this role partners with our local marketing teams to oversee delivery of Local SEO, AI Visibility (AIO/GEO), Google Business Profile, Local Listings, and organic Social Media programs — and serves as the client’s voice for those channels on monthly performance calls.

The Senior Paid Media Manager will report to the Director, Franchise Partnerships. The position will also work with our global support teams within AdMax Local. You should be able to work well as part of a distributed team and provide innovative solutions to the new problems and opportunities that arise every week. In addition, you should have the ability to function equally well independently and as part of a team, as well as the ability to adapt to the changing digital marketing landscape and the use of AI.

This remote role may require one in-person client event per year.

**Key Responsibilities:**

- Plan, develop, and execute comprehensive paid media strategies to drive revenue, direct response, qualified leads, and new user acquisition for your book of clients
- Utilize business acumen to work closely with client teams to identify and fully understand business needs, campaign performance objectives, and opportunities to grow relationships and client investments
- Manage Search, Performance Max, Display, Social, Remarketing, and Video advertising campaigns within the native Google, Meta, and Microsoft platforms and the proprietary AdMax Local platform
- Oversee delivery of Local SEO, AI Visibility (AIO/GEO), Google Business Profile/Local Listings, and organic Social Media programs executed by specialized internal teams, ensuring on-time, on-brand, and on-strategy execution for every client (this role manages and quality-checks the work)
- Confidently communicate strategy and campaign progress to clients through weekly calls and emails; Present and discuss organic/local SEO and AI Visibility performance on monthly client performance calls, translating concepts, deliverables, and results into clear business impact
- Provide recommendations and execute strategies for ad copy, keyword opportunities, campaign structuring, targeting, creative, display network, and other facets of Google inventory
- Integrate consumer and business insights into media to enhance targeting and tracking efforts
- Optimize performance marketing campaigns to meet and exceed SEM and paid social campaign benchmarks through channel-specific levers utilizing industry best practices
- Responsible for monthly reporting on campaign performance with a keen eye toward media optimization to ensure efficient and effective campaign execution
- Responsible for tight management of paid media budget, providing timely management of platform setup, invoicing, and accruals
- Manage the creative development process, including writing creative briefs, trafficking, creative insights, ensuring timely delivery, and alignment with client direction. Requires a solid understanding of the creative process and creative development best business practices.

**Qualifications:**

- US-based applicants only
- 7+ years of experience managing multiple client portfolios in SEM (Search, Display, Remarketing, App Install). 1+ years of Performance Max and Shopping experience.
- 5-7+ years of experience managing multiple client portfolios in paid social (Facebook/Instagram)
- TikTok, Snapchat, Pinterest, and Twitter are a plus
- Working knowledge of Local SEO, Google Business Profile, local listings/citation management, online reputation management, and organic social media management — sufficient to oversee specialist teams and confidently discuss performance and recommendations with clients on monthly calls
- Familiarity with AI Visibility / Answer Engine Optimization (AIO/GEO) concepts and how they intersect with traditional SEO
- 7+ years of experience in Client Management (Must be comfortable with a high volume of client meetings, some weeks)
- Experience working and developing strategies for clients with multiple franchise locations.
- Strong ability to multitask, prioritize, and respond with an appropriate sense of urgency in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
- Proven track record of successfully planning and executing Paid Search, Paid Social, Paid Display, and YouTube campaign management and optimizations at scale
- Strong analytical skills and experience with data analysis, attribution, ads implementation, and platform integration (Excel skills required)
- Detail-oriented, able to build project plans and presentations with strategic input
- A proactive mindset, strong work ethic, and ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional leads and existing teams
- Experience driving campaigns from concept through to execution, and performing post-campaign analysis
- Experience with analytics/tracking tools: Google Analytics (Universal & GA4), SEMRush, Google Tag Manager, Meta Business Suite
- Experience optimizing landing pages and performing A/B and multivariate testing
- Experience leveraging AI to improve the quality of work output and turnaround time
- Ability to work both independently and as part of a team in a professional business environment
- Bachelor’s degree required, Master’s degree a plus
- Bing Ads Accredited Professional (Preferred)
- Google AdWords Certified (Preferred)
- Meta BluePrint Certified (Preferred)
- Google Analytics Certified is a plus

**Compensation & Benefits:**

- Salary range $90k - $120k depending on experience and location
- Remote environment
- Health/dental/vision benefits
- Unlimited PTO
- 401(k) plan

<p>We are seeking a Senior Paid Media Manager with deep client-facing and local marketing experience to join our expanding team. You’ll directly manage search engine marketing (SEM) campaigns across both Google Ads (Search, Display, Shopping, Performance Max, YouTube) and Microsoft Ads, making optimizations and updates daily. You will also support the team with Meta Ads campaigns. Your complex and diverse portfolio of clients will be a mix of local and SMBs that constantly challenge you with goals to maximize performance, reach, and customer acquisition across these channels. In addition to managing paid media execution, this role partners with our local marketing teams to oversee delivery of Local SEO, AI Visibility (AIO/GEO), Google Business Profile, Local Listings, and organic Social Media programs — and serves as the client’s voice for those channels on monthly performance calls.</p>
<p>The Senior Paid Media Manager will report to the Director, Franchise Partnerships. The position will also work with our global support teams within AdMax Local. You should be able to work well as part of a distributed team and provide innovative solutions to the new problems and opportunities that arise every week. In addition, you should have the ability to function equally well independently and as part of a team, as well as the ability to adapt to the changing digital marketing landscape and the use of AI.</p>
<p>This remote role may require one in-person client event per year.</p>
<p><b>Key Responsibilities:</b></p>
<ul>
 <li>Plan, develop, and execute comprehensive paid media strategies to drive revenue, direct response, qualified leads, and new user acquisition for your book of clients</li>
 <li>Utilize business acumen to work closely with client teams to identify and fully understand business needs, campaign performance objectives, and opportunities to grow relationships and client investments</li>
 <li>Manage Search, Performance Max, Display, Social, Remarketing, and Video advertising campaigns within the native Google, Meta, and Microsoft platforms and the proprietary AdMax Local platform</li>
 <li>Oversee delivery of Local SEO, AI Visibility (AIO/GEO), Google Business Profile/Local Listings, and organic Social Media programs executed by specialized internal teams, ensuring on-time, on-brand, and on-strategy execution for every client (this role manages and quality-checks the work)</li>
 <li>Confidently communicate strategy and campaign progress to clients through weekly calls and emails; Present and discuss organic/local SEO and AI Visibility performance on monthly client performance calls, translating concepts, deliverables, and results into clear business impact</li>
 <li>Provide recommendations and execute strategies for ad copy, keyword opportunities, campaign structuring, targeting, creative, display network, and other facets of Google inventory</li>
 <li>Integrate consumer and business insights into media to enhance targeting and tracking efforts</li>
 <li>Optimize performance marketing campaigns to meet and exceed SEM and paid social campaign benchmarks through channel-specific levers utilizing industry best practices</li>
 <li>Responsible for monthly reporting on campaign performance with a keen eye toward media optimization to ensure efficient and effective campaign execution</li>
 <li>Responsible for tight management of paid media budget, providing timely management of platform setup, invoicing, and accruals</li>
 <li>Manage the creative development process, including writing creative briefs, trafficking, creative insights, ensuring timely delivery, and alignment with client direction. Requires a solid understanding of the creative process and creative development best business practices.</li>
</ul>
<p><b>Qualifications:</b></p>
<ul>
 <li>US-based applicants only</li>
 <li>7+ years of experience managing multiple client portfolios in SEM (Search, Display, Remarketing, App Install). 1+ years of Performance Max and Shopping experience.</li>
 <li>5-7+ years of experience managing multiple client portfolios in paid social (Facebook/Instagram)</li>
 <li>TikTok, Snapchat, Pinterest, and Twitter are a plus</li>
 <li>Working knowledge of Local SEO, Google Business Profile, local listings/citation management, online reputation management, and organic social media management — sufficient to oversee specialist teams and confidently discuss performance and recommendations with clients on monthly calls</li>
 <li>Familiarity with AI Visibility / Answer Engine Optimization (AIO/GEO) concepts and how they intersect with traditional SEO</li>
 <li>7+ years of experience in Client Management (Must be comfortable with a high volume of client meetings, some weeks)</li>
 <li>Experience working and developing strategies for clients with multiple franchise locations.</li>
 <li>Strong ability to multitask, prioritize, and respond with an appropriate sense of urgency in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment</li>
 <li>Proven track record of successfully planning and executing Paid Search, Paid Social, Paid Display, and YouTube campaign management and optimizations at scale</li>
 <li>Strong analytical skills and experience with data analysis, attribution, ads implementation, and platform integration (Excel skills required)</li>
 <li>Detail-oriented, able to build project plans and presentations with strategic input</li>
 <li>A proactive mindset, strong work ethic, and ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional leads and existing teams</li>
 <li>Experience driving campaigns from concept through to execution, and performing post-campaign analysis</li>
 <li>Experience with analytics/tracking tools: Google Analytics (Universal & GA4), SEMRush, Google Tag Manager, Meta Business Suite</li>
 <li>Experience optimizing landing pages and performing A/B and multivariate testing</li>
 <li>Experience leveraging AI to improve the quality of work output and turnaround time</li>
 <li>Ability to work both independently and as part of a team in a professional business environment</li>
 <li>Bachelor’s degree required, Master’s degree a plus</li>
 <li>Bing Ads Accredited Professional (Preferred)</li>
 <li>Google AdWords Certified (Preferred)</li>
 <li>Meta BluePrint Certified (Preferred)</li>
 <li>Google Analytics Certified is a plus</li>
</ul>
<p><b>Compensation & Benefits:</b></p>
<ul>
 <li>Salary range $90k - $120k depending on experience and location</li>
 <li>Remote environment</li>
 <li>Health/dental/vision benefits</li>
 <li>Unlimited PTO</li>
 <li>401(k) plan</li>
</ul>
<p>Pay: $90,000.00 - $120,000.00 per year</p>

<ul>

</ul>

#### Full job description

Onda (https://ondaworks.com/) partners with brands to help them grow, by way of our pool of highly vetted talent experts within all areas of digital marketing. Onda acts as a "one-stop-shop" for e-commerce brands seeking assistance with their digital marketing labor and execution needs by providing premium talent. Joining our talent network offers you connections to the ultimate “freelance” gigs with our clients, but coupled with a variety of support departments (scheduling, billing, client resolution, etc) to help you focus on what you do best.


As a Senior Paid Media Strategist, you will be responsible for developing, implementing, and managing paid media strategies that drive high-quality traffic and conversions for our DTC ecommerce clients. You will leverage your expertise in various paid media channels to create and execute data-driven campaigns that align with our clients’ business objectives. Your role will involve strategic planning, performance analysis, and collaboration with cross-functional teams to ensure the success of our clients' digital marketing initiatives. You’ll also provide strategy, guidance and oversight to the junior ad buyers within the Onda Team that are assigned to any given client account that you are associated with.

Responsibilities:

- Develop and implement comprehensive paid media strategies for DTC ecommerce brands across multiple platforms (e.g., Google Ads, Facebook/Meta Ads, Instagram Ads, TikTok Ads, etc.).

- Strategize on and manage high-impact ad campaigns that drive customer acquisition, engagement, and retention.

- Continuously advise Junior Buyer on how to optimize campaign performance through A/B testing, audience segmentation, and data analysis.

- Conduct market research and competitive analysis to identify new advertising opportunities and industry trends.

- Monitor ad performance and adjust campaigns accordingly to improve conversion rates and ROI.

- Monitor and analyze campaign performance, providing actionable insights and recommendations to improve ROI and achieve client goals.

- Present and discuss performance reports and strategic recommendations to clients and internal teams.

- Utilize analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics, Facebook Insights, etc.) to track key metrics and identify trends.

- Serve as the main point of contact for clients regarding paid media strategy and execution.

- Understand clients’ business objectives, challenges, and industry trends to tailor strategies that meet their needs.

- Build and maintain strong client relationships, ensuring high levels of satisfaction and retention.

- Work closely with creative, content, and design teams to develop compelling ad creatives and messaging.

- Collaborate with data analysts and developers to ensure accurate tracking and reporting of campaign performance.

- Stay informed about industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices to drive innovation and stay ahead of the competition.

- Oversee paid media budgets, ensuring optimal allocation and spend efficiency.

- Provide recommendations for budget adjustments based on performance and business needs.


**Skills & Qualifications:**

- 5+ years of experience in paid media strategy and execution, with a focus on Direct to Consumer ecommerce brands.

- Proven track record of managing and optimizing successful paid media campaigns across various digital platforms.

- Strong analytical skills to interpret data and adjust strategies accordingly.

- Creative thinking and problem-solving skills to develop unique and effective ad campaigns.

- Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, generate insights, and make data-driven decisions.

- Expert level proficiency in using paid media tools and platforms (e.g., Google Ads, Facebook Ads Manager, TikTok Ads Manager, etc.).

- Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex information clearly and effectively.

- Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.

- Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive, results-oriented mindset.

- Must be an outstanding, proactive, responsive communicator!

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

- Strong attention to detail and ability to meet tight deadlines.


**What We Offer:**

- Fully remote

- 1099 independent contractor position

- Flexible hours - work as much as you want!

- Opportunities for professional growth and development

- Exposure to dozens of brands

- Multiple support teams to assist you (billing, scheduling, client management, quality assurance)

- NOTE: The typical Onda contract requires between 6-10 hours per month, per client, with a maximum rate of $100 per hour, depending on experience. Weekly call, per client, is required.


Apply today to join the Onda network for the opportunity to work with exciting and innovative brands!

Onda is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

fields.responsibilities:
- Develop and implement comprehensive paid media strategies for DTC ecommerce brands across multiple platforms (e.g., Google Ads, Facebook/Meta Ads, Instagram Ads, TikTok Ads, etc.).

- Strategize on and manage high-impact ad campaigns that drive customer acquisition, engagement, and retention.

- Continuously advise Junior Buyer on how to optimize campaign performance through A/B testing, audience segmentation, and data analysis.

- Conduct market research and competitive analysis to identify new advertising opportunities and industry trends.

- Monitor ad performance and adjust campaigns accordingly to improve conversion rates and ROI.

- Monitor and analyze campaign performance, providing actionable insights and recommendations to improve ROI and achieve client goals.

- Present and discuss performance reports and strategic recommendations to clients and internal teams.

- Utilize analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics, Facebook Insights, etc.) to track key metrics and identify trends.

- Serve as the main point of contact for clients regarding paid media strategy and execution.

- Understand clients’ business objectives, challenges, and industry trends to tailor strategies that meet their needs.

- Build and maintain strong client relationships, ensuring high levels of satisfaction and retention.

- Work closely with creative, content, and design teams to develop compelling ad creatives and messaging.

- Collaborate with data analysts and developers to ensure accurate tracking and reporting of campaign performance.

- Stay informed about industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices to drive innovation and stay ahead of the competition.

- Oversee paid media budgets, ensuring optimal allocation and spend efficiency.

- Provide recommendations for budget adjustments based on performance and business needs.


**Skills & Qualifications:**

- 5+ years of experience in paid media strategy and execution, with a focus on Direct to Consumer ecommerce brands.

- Proven track record of managing and optimizing successful paid media campaigns across various digital platforms.

- Strong analytical skills to interpret data and adjust strategies accordingly.

- Creative thinking and problem-solving skills to develop unique and effective ad campaigns.

- Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, generate insights, and make data-driven decisions.

- Expert level proficiency in using paid media tools and platforms (e.g., Google Ads, Facebook Ads Manager, TikTok Ads Manager, etc.).

- Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex information clearly and effectively.

- Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.

- Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive, results-oriented mindset.

- Must be an outstanding, proactive, responsive communicator!

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

- Strong attention to detail and ability to meet tight deadlines.


**What We Offer:**

- Fully remote

- 1099 independent contractor position

- Flexible hours - work as much as you want!

- Opportunities for professional growth and development

- Exposure to dozens of brands

- Multiple support teams to assist you (billing, scheduling, client management, quality assurance)

- NOTE: The typical Onda contract requires between 6-10 hours per month, per client, with a maximum rate of $100 per hour, depending on experience. Weekly call, per client, is required.


Apply today to join the Onda network for the opportunity to work with exciting and innovative brands!

Onda is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

#### Full job description

Onda (https://ondaworks.com/) partners with brands to help them grow, by way of our pool of highly vetted talent experts within all areas of digital marketing. Onda acts as a "one-stop-shop" for e-commerce brands seeking assistance with their digital marketing labor and execution needs by providing premium talent. Joining our talent network offers you connections to the ultimate “freelance” gigs with our clients, but coupled with a variety of support departments (scheduling, billing, client resolution, etc) to help you focus on what you do best.


As a Senior Paid Media Strategist, you will be responsible for developing, implementing, and managing paid media strategies that drive high-quality traffic and conversions for our DTC ecommerce clients. You will leverage your expertise in various paid media channels to create and execute data-driven campaigns that align with our clients’ business objectives. Your role will involve strategic planning, performance analysis, and collaboration with cross-functional teams to ensure the success of our clients' digital marketing initiatives. You’ll also provide strategy, guidance and oversight to the junior ad buyers within the Onda Team that are assigned to any given client account that you are associated with.

Responsibilities:

- Develop and implement comprehensive paid media strategies for DTC ecommerce brands across multiple platforms (e.g., Google Ads, Facebook/Meta Ads, Instagram Ads, TikTok Ads, etc.).

- Strategize on and manage high-impact ad campaigns that drive customer acquisition, engagement, and retention.

- Continuously advise Junior Buyer on how to optimize campaign performance through A/B testing, audience segmentation, and data analysis.

- Conduct market research and competitive analysis to identify new advertising opportunities and industry trends.

- Monitor ad performance and adjust campaigns accordingly to improve conversion rates and ROI.

- Monitor and analyze campaign performance, providing actionable insights and recommendations to improve ROI and achieve client goals.

- Present and discuss performance reports and strategic recommendations to clients and internal teams.

- Utilize analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics, Facebook Insights, etc.) to track key metrics and identify trends.

- Serve as the main point of contact for clients regarding paid media strategy and execution.

- Understand clients’ business objectives, challenges, and industry trends to tailor strategies that meet their needs.

- Build and maintain strong client relationships, ensuring high levels of satisfaction and retention.

- Work closely with creative, content, and design teams to develop compelling ad creatives and messaging.

- Collaborate with data analysts and developers to ensure accurate tracking and reporting of campaign performance.

- Stay informed about industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices to drive innovation and stay ahead of the competition.

- Oversee paid media budgets, ensuring optimal allocation and spend efficiency.

- Provide recommendations for budget adjustments based on performance and business needs.


**Skills & Qualifications:**

- 5+ years of experience in paid media strategy and execution, with a focus on Direct to Consumer ecommerce brands.

- Proven track record of managing and optimizing successful paid media campaigns across various digital platforms.

- Strong analytical skills to interpret data and adjust strategies accordingly.

- Creative thinking and problem-solving skills to develop unique and effective ad campaigns.

- Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, generate insights, and make data-driven decisions.

- Expert level proficiency in using paid media tools and platforms (e.g., Google Ads, Facebook Ads Manager, TikTok Ads Manager, etc.).

- Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex information clearly and effectively.

- Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.

- Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive, results-oriented mindset.

- Must be an outstanding, proactive, responsive communicator!

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

- Strong attention to detail and ability to meet tight deadlines.


**What We Offer:**

- Fully remote

- 1099 independent contractor position

- Flexible hours - work as much as you want!

- Opportunities for professional growth and development

- Exposure to dozens of brands

- Multiple support teams to assist you (billing, scheduling, client management, quality assurance)

- NOTE: The typical Onda contract requires between 6-10 hours per month, per client, with a maximum rate of $100 per hour, depending on experience. Weekly call, per client, is required.


Apply today to join the Onda network for the opportunity to work with exciting and innovative brands!

Onda is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Onda (https://ondaworks.com/) partners with brands to help them grow, by way of our pool of highly vetted talent experts within all areas of digital marketing. Onda acts as a "one-stop-shop" for e-commerce brands seeking assistance with their digital marketing labor and execution needs by providing premium talent. Joining our talent network offers you connections to the ultimate “freelance” gigs with our clients, but coupled with a variety of support departments (scheduling, billing, client resolution, etc) to help you focus on what you do best.

As a Senior Paid Media Strategist, you will be responsible for developing, implementing, and managing paid media strategies that drive high-quality traffic and conversions for our DTC ecommerce clients. You will leverage your expertise in various paid media channels to create and execute data-driven campaigns that align with our clients’ business objectives. Your role will involve strategic planning, performance analysis, and collaboration with cross-functional teams to ensure the success of our clients' digital marketing initiatives. You’ll also provide strategy, guidance and oversight to the junior ad buyers within the Onda Team that are assigned to any given client account that you are associated with.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and implement comprehensive paid media strategies for DTC ecommerce brands across multiple platforms (e.g., Google Ads, Facebook/Meta Ads, Instagram Ads, TikTok Ads, etc.).

  • Strategize on and manage high-impact ad campaigns that drive customer acquisition, engagement, and retention.

  • Continuously advise Junior Buyer on how to optimize campaign performance through A/B testing, audience segmentation, and data analysis.

  • Conduct market research and competitive analysis to identify new advertising opportunities and industry trends.

  • Monitor ad performance and adjust campaigns accordingly to improve conversion rates and ROI.

  • Monitor and analyze campaign performance, providing actionable insights and recommendations to improve ROI and achieve client goals.

  • Present and discuss performance reports and strategic recommendations to clients and internal teams.

  • Utilize analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics, Facebook Insights, etc.) to track key metrics and identify trends.

  • Serve as the main point of contact for clients regarding paid media strategy and execution.

  • Understand clients’ business objectives, challenges, and industry trends to tailor strategies that meet their needs.

  • Build and maintain strong client relationships, ensuring high levels of satisfaction and retention.

  • Work closely with creative, content, and design teams to develop compelling ad creatives and messaging.

  • Collaborate with data analysts and developers to ensure accurate tracking and reporting of campaign performance.

  • Stay informed about industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices to drive innovation and stay ahead of the competition.

  • Oversee paid media budgets, ensuring optimal allocation and spend efficiency.

  • Provide recommendations for budget adjustments based on performance and business needs.

Skills & Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience in paid media strategy and execution, with a focus on Direct to Consumer ecommerce brands.

  • Proven track record of managing and optimizing successful paid media campaigns across various digital platforms.

  • Strong analytical skills to interpret data and adjust strategies accordingly.

  • Creative thinking and problem-solving skills to develop unique and effective ad campaigns.

  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, generate insights, and make data-driven decisions.

  • Expert level proficiency in using paid media tools and platforms (e.g., Google Ads, Facebook Ads Manager, TikTok Ads Manager, etc.).

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex information clearly and effectively.

  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive, results-oriented mindset.

  • Must be an outstanding, proactive, responsive communicator!

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to meet tight deadlines.

What We Offer:

  • Fully remote

  • 1099 independent contractor position

  • Flexible hours - work as much as you want!

  • Opportunities for professional growth and development

  • Exposure to dozens of brands

  • Multiple support teams to assist you (billing, scheduling, client management, quality assurance)

  • NOTE: The typical Onda contract requires between 6-10 hours per month, per client, with a maximum rate of $100 per hour, depending on experience. Weekly call, per client, is required.

Apply today to join the Onda network for the opportunity to work with exciting and innovative brands!

Onda is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

<div>
 Onda (https://ondaworks.com/) partners with brands to help them grow, by way of our pool of highly vetted talent experts within all areas of digital marketing. Onda acts as a "one-stop-shop" for e-commerce brands seeking assistance with their digital marketing labor and execution needs by providing premium talent. Joining our talent network offers you connections to the ultimate “freelance” gigs with our clients, but coupled with a variety of support departments (scheduling, billing, client resolution, etc) to help you focus on what you do best. 
 <p>As a Senior Paid Media Strategist, you will be responsible for developing, implementing, and managing paid media strategies that drive high-quality traffic and conversions for our DTC ecommerce clients. You will leverage your expertise in various paid media channels to create and execute data-driven campaigns that align with our clients’ business objectives. Your role will involve strategic planning, performance analysis, and collaboration with cross-functional teams to ensure the success of our clients' digital marketing initiatives. You’ll also provide strategy, guidance and oversight to the junior ad buyers within the Onda Team that are assigned to any given client account that you are associated with.</p>
 <p>Responsibilities:</p>
 <ul>
  <li>
   <p>Develop and implement comprehensive paid media strategies for DTC ecommerce brands across multiple platforms (e.g., Google Ads, Facebook/Meta Ads, Instagram Ads, TikTok Ads, etc.).</p></li>
  <li>
   <p>Strategize on and manage high-impact ad campaigns that drive customer acquisition, engagement, and retention.</p></li>
  <li>
   <p>Continuously advise Junior Buyer on how to optimize campaign performance through A/B testing, audience segmentation, and data analysis.</p></li>
  <li>
   <p>Conduct market research and competitive analysis to identify new advertising opportunities and industry trends.</p></li>
  <li>
   <p>Monitor ad performance and adjust campaigns accordingly to improve conversion rates and ROI.</p></li>
  <li>
   <p>Monitor and analyze campaign performance, providing actionable insights and recommendations to improve ROI and achieve client goals.</p></li>
  <li>
   <p>Present and discuss performance reports and strategic recommendations to clients and internal teams.</p></li>
  <li>
   <p>Utilize analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics, Facebook Insights, etc.) to track key metrics and identify trends.</p></li>
  <li>
   <p>Serve as the main point of contact for clients regarding paid media strategy and execution.</p></li>
  <li>
   <p>Understand clients’ business objectives, challenges, and industry trends to tailor strategies that meet their needs.</p></li>
  <li>
   <p>Build and maintain strong client relationships, ensuring high levels of satisfaction and retention.</p></li>
  <li>
   <p>Work closely with creative, content, and design teams to develop compelling ad creatives and messaging.</p></li>
  <li>
   <p>Collaborate with data analysts and developers to ensure accurate tracking and reporting of campaign performance.</p></li>
  <li>
   <p>Stay informed about industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices to drive innovation and stay ahead of the competition.</p></li>
  <li>
   <p>Oversee paid media budgets, ensuring optimal allocation and spend efficiency.</p></li>
  <li>
   <p>Provide recommendations for budget adjustments based on performance and business needs.</p></li>
 </ul>
 <p><b>Skills & Qualifications: </b></p>
 <ul>
  <li>
   <p>5+ years of experience in paid media strategy and execution, with a focus on Direct to Consumer ecommerce brands.</p></li>
  <li>
   <p>Proven track record of managing and optimizing successful paid media campaigns across various digital platforms.</p></li>
  <li>
   <p>Strong analytical skills to interpret data and adjust strategies accordingly.</p></li>
  <li>
   <p>Creative thinking and problem-solving skills to develop unique and effective ad campaigns.</p></li>
  <li>
   <p>Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, generate insights, and make data-driven decisions.</p></li>
  <li>
   <p>Expert level proficiency in using paid media tools and platforms (e.g., Google Ads, Facebook Ads Manager, TikTok Ads Manager, etc.).</p></li>
  <li>
   <p>Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex information clearly and effectively.</p></li>
  <li>
   <p>Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.</p></li>
  <li>
   <p>Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive, results-oriented mindset.</p></li>
  <li>
   <p>Must be an outstanding, proactive, responsive communicator!</p></li>
  <li>
   <p>Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.</p></li>
  <li>
   <p>Strong attention to detail and ability to meet tight deadlines.</p></li>
 </ul>
 <p><b>What We Offer: </b></p>
 <ul>
  <li>
   <p>Fully remote</p></li>
  <li>
   <p>1099 independent contractor position</p></li>
  <li>
   <p>Flexible hours - work as much as you want!</p></li>
  <li>
   <p>Opportunities for professional growth and development</p></li>
  <li>
   <p>Exposure to dozens of brands</p></li>
  <li>
   <p>Multiple support teams to assist you (billing, scheduling, client management, quality assurance)</p></li>
  <li>
   <p>NOTE: The typical Onda contract requires between 6-10 hours per month, per client, with a maximum rate of $100 per hour, depending on experience. Weekly call, per client, is required.</p></li>
 </ul>
 <p>Apply today to join the Onda network for the opportunity to work with exciting and innovative brands!</p>
 <p>Onda is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.</p>

#### Job details

$53,500 - $65,000 a year

401(k) 4% Match, Parental leave, 401(k), Health insurance, 401(k) matching, Health savings account, Flexible spending account, Life insurance

Show 1 more

Full-time

Hybrid work in 2600 W Executive Pkwy # 180, Lehi, UT 84043

#### Full job description

Our mission at 97th Floor is to elevate people and brands we believe in. That’s what we’re focused on when we help our clients meet their marketing goals and lead people to brands and products they need.

You’ll thrive here if you’re motivated to do work you’re proud of, you enjoy close collaboration, and you’re naturally curious about how search engines and AI search actually work.

We’ve partnered with companies like AT&T, Oatly, eos, and Zoom. And now we’re looking for someone who wants to join our team with organic search expertise, fresh eyes, and genuine excitement to achieve results.

What You’ll Do

As a Senior Search Marketer, you’ll bring deep search expertise that you can apply to your own clients and share with others. You’ll own SEO and AI search/GEO strategy for your clients while helping train and develop other marketers across the department.

You’ll also work closely with the Head of Search to push our search offering forward through testing new strategies, developing and validating new approaches, turning successful tests into case studies, and helping bring those learnings to the rest of the department. You’ll help turn what works into repeatable strategies we can apply across clients and package into sales and marketing materials that demonstrate our expertise.

You’ll work alongside a content marketer, advertiser, designer, and account director on a team serving approximately 7–10 clients. Your work will focus on:

Content Strategy

- Ensure query research (keyword and AI prompt research), content mapping, and content consolidation are happening on the cadence each client’s SOW calls for, and take ownership of the strategic direction that comes out of them.
- Collaborate with content, advertising, and design teams to align SEO initiatives with broader marketing goals.
- Stay ahead of algorithm changes, platform updates, and emerging search trends — including AI-driven search — and share what you learn with the broader team.

Technical Fixes

- Own the account’s technical health strategy, making sure Full Technical Audits and ongoing monitoring are happening on schedule and issues are resolved before they affect performance.

Internal Linking

- Ensure internal link audits and strategy are being executed on schedule across the account, and take ownership of the strategic direction behind them.
- Optimize existing internal links to create correct connection between hub and spoke pages.
- Audit a site's existing URL structure, provide recommendations for optimizing user and bot navigation of a site.

Backlink Acquisition

- Take ownership of backlink fulfillment relationships with BASE or outside contractors, making sure strategic allocation, anchor text guidance, and outreach recommendations are being followed and producing quality links (DR30+, doFollow, indexable, relevant).
- Quality-assurance audits and tracking impact of new referring links on keyword rankings, traffic and AI Search presence.link impact via STAT annotation.

Results Tracking and Monitoring

- Own performance against defined client goals and target outcomes, proactively identifying and executing the strategies needed to drive measurable results.
- Closely monitor results across STAT, Ahrefs, GSC, and GA4, and be the one to raise the alarm early when performance is off track and leading the strategy pivot needed to improve it.
- Own client communication and reporting for your accounts’ SEO initiatives, confidently explaining strategy, results, and recommendations in a way that connects search metrics to real business outcomes.
- Contribute to process improvement and knowledge sharing, helping evolve internal playbooks, templates, and reporting standards for the search marketing team.

What We’re Looking For

- Bachelor’s degree in marketing or a related field (preferred, not required)
- 3+ years of experience in SEO/organic search, including experience owning strategy across multiple client accounts
- A demonstrated track record of driving measurable organic search results
- Advanced proficiency with GA4, Google Search Console, Looker Studio, Screaming Frog and Ahrefs (or comparable tools)
- Skilled in interpreting performance data and translating it into a clear, client-ready narrative — not just what happened, but why
- Strong analytical and strategic thinking, with the ability to prioritize where a client’s SEO investment will have the biggest impact
- Experience directing or coordinating outside contractor/vendor relationships (e.g., link-building partners) is a plus
- Advanced client communication and influence skills, with the ability to advise senior marketing leaders and C-suite executives, translate search performance into business impact, and build buy-in for strategic recommendations.

Benefits

Healthcare

- Medical: 75% paid for employees; 50% for dependents
- Dental: 75% paid for employees; 50% for dependents
- Vision: 75% paid for employees; 50% for dependents
- Life Insurance: 100% paid by 97th Floor (coverage = 1x salary, up to $350,000)

Savings + Retirement

- HSA with up to $150/month match (rolls over and is yours permanently)
- FSA option for dependent care
- 401(k) with up to 4% company match

ROWE (Results Only Work Environment)

This is a big one. We don’t track hours, but we care deeply about results. You work when, where, and how you want — as long as the work gets done. No vacation policy, no time tracking, no office requirements. Autonomy and accountability go hand in hand here. You’re always welcome in our Lehi office (coworkers + snacks!), but you choose when you come in.

Parental Leave

- Primary caregiver: 12 consecutive weeks paid
- Secondary caregiver: 6 consecutive weeks paid

Perks

- 97th Floor Library: Ask for a book and we’ll buy it. Read anything already on the shelf. No checkouts required.
- Conferences & Training: We cover most online trainings and local conferences, plus occasional out-of-state events (travel included) with manager approval.
- On-site Gym: 24/7 access with lockers and showers.
- Thanksgiving Point Corporate Pass: Up to 8 people per visit; discounts included.
- Sundance Corporate Pass: Winter and summer access for skiing, boarding, hiking, and more.

_Note: Benefits and perks can change._
